title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 17 章‧髮與甲的處置

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
... ashâum kem aojishta mahrka mashyâka daêvô
aoshô ýazâite.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent
Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which is the
most deadly deed whereby a man offers up a sacrifice to the Daevas?'

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hâu bâ
ashâum zarathushtra ýô aêtahmi anghvô
ýat astvaiñti varesåsca hãm-râzayeiti
varesåsca pairi-brîneñti srvaêca upa-thwereseñti
atha dim upa-taoshayeiñti ûnâhva dim raêshayaca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is when a man here below, combing
his hair or shaving it off, or paring off his nails, drops them
in a hole or in a crack.

segments.orig:
âat âhva vyarethâhva zemô daêva
hãm-bavaiñti âat âhva vyarethâhva
zemô xrafstra hãm-bavaiñti ýim mashyâka
spish nãma aojaite ýim mashyâka ýaom
ýavô-hva nizhgangheñti vastra vastrâhva.
segments.en:
'Then by this transgression of the rites, Daevas are produced
in the earth; by this transgression of the rites, those Khrafstras
are produced in the earth which men call lice, and which eat up
the corn in the corn-field and the clothes in the wardrobe.

segments.orig:
âat ýat tûm zarathushtra aêtahmi
anghvô ýat astvaiñti varesåsca hãm-râzayanguha
varesåsca pairi-brînanguha srvaêca upa-thweresanguha,
âat tûm pascaêta apa-barôish dasa-gâim
haca nerebyô ashavabyô vîsata-gâim haca
âthrat thrisata-gâim haca apat pañcâsata-gâim
haca baresmen frastairyât.
segments.en:
'Therefore, thou, O Zarathushtra! whenever here below thou
shalt comb thy hair or shave it off, or pare off thy nails, thou
shalt take them away ten paces from the faithful, twenty paces
from the fire, thirty paces from the water, fifty paces from the
consecrated bundles of Baresma.

segments.orig:
âat athra makhem ava-kanôish dîshtîm
xrûzhdisme vîtastîm varedusme paiti dim âbarôish
atha imã vacô framruyå vârethrakhnîsh
zarathushtra, at ah'yâi ashâ mazdå urvarå
vaxshat.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt dig a hole, a disti deep if the earth be
hard, a vitasti deep if it be soft; thou shalt take the hair down
there and thou shalt say aloud these victorious words:
 
"For him, as a reward, Mazda made the plants grow up."

segments.orig:
xshathrâi vairyâi pairi-karem pairi-kârayôish
tishrô ýat vâ xshvash ýat vâ nava
ahunemca vairîm frasrâvayôish tishrô ýat
vâ xshvash ýat vâ nava.
segments.en:
'Thereupon thou shalt draw three furrows with a knife of metal
around the hole, or six furrows or nine, and thou shall chant
the Ahuna-Vairya three times, or six, or nine.
 
 II.

segments.orig:
srvâbya makhem ava-kanôish nishtara-naêmât
nmânahe avat aipi ýatha kasishtahe erezvô fratemem
tbishish, paiti dim âbarôish atha imã vacô
framruyå vârethrakhnîsh zarathushtra, ashâ
vohû mananghâ ýâ sruyê parê
magaonô.
segments.en:
'For the nails, thou shalt dig a hole, out of the house, as
deep as the top joint of the little finger; thou shalt take the
nails down there and thou shalt say aloud these victorious words:
 
"The things that the pure proclaim through Asha and Vohu-mano."

segments.orig:
xshathrâi vairyâi pairi-karem pairi-kârayôish
tishrô ýat vâ xshvash ýat vâ nava
ahunemca vairîm frasrâvayôish tishrô ýat
vâ xshvash ýat vâ nava.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt draw three furrows with a knife of metal
around the hole, or six furrows or nine, and thou shalt chant
the Ahuna-Vairya three times, or six, or nine.

segments.orig:
paiti tê merekha ashô-zushta imå srvå
vaêdhayemi imå srvå âvaêdhayemi
imåse-tê srvå merekha ashô- zushta hyâre
arshtayasca karetayasca thanvareca ishavasca erezifyô-parena
asanasca fradaxshanya paiti daêvô mâzanyãn.
segments.en:
'And then:
 
"O Asho-zushta bird! these nails I announce
and consecrate unto thee. May they be for thee so many spears
and knives, so many bows and falcon-winged arrows and so many
sling-stones against the Mazainya Daevas!"

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit paiti-vaêdhayeiñti tå
srvå pascaêta bun mâzainyanãm daêvanãm
arshtayasca karetayasca thanvareca ishavasca erezifyô-parena
asanasca fradaxshanya paiti daêvô mâzanyãn.
segments.en:
'If those nails have not been consecrated (to the bird), they
shall be in the hands of the Mazainya Daevas so many spears and
knives so many bows and falcon-winged arrows, and so many sling-stones
(against the Mazainya Daevas).

segments.orig:
vîspe drvañtô tanu-drujô ýô
aderetô-tkaêshô vîspe aderetô-tkaêshô
ýô asraoshô vîspe asraoshô ýô
anashavanô vîspe anashavanô ýô
tanu-perethô! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'All wicked, embodiments of the Druj, are scorners of the
judge: all scorners of the judge are rebels against the Sovereign:
all rebels against the Sovereign are ungodly men; and all ungodly
men are worthy of death.'
